title: CliArgument
description: One argument of a command or a verb. An argument is a FIELD of what declares it, not a thing with its own identity — which is where the declaration tree stops: a directory per flag would be fragmentation rather than structure.

name.description: The flag as typed (--session) or the positional's name. A flag never names a value of an axis its command already enumerates (G21).

type.description: The value metavar — <uuid8>, claude|gemini — and empty for a boolean flag, which is how a flag is told from an option.

cardinality.description: Empty is optional; `1` is exactly one, required; `*` is any number (a variadic positional tail); `N/<class>` is N over the set quotient by <class>, the mutually-exclusive args sharing that class being one equivalence class.

help.description: The wording argparse shows for this argument; the declaration owns structure and words alike (#477).

default.description: What an omitted argument means, as data (#477): a path-typed argument's default is repo-relative and resolves against the root at parser build; any other passes verbatim. Shown in the generated help as declared, so no help prose restates it.
